instruction: A folded paper airship with a long faceted cigar-shaped hull and a small creased gondola hanging beneath. Sharp mountain and valley folds define the tapered nose and finned tail, all formed from a single sheet of pale ivory paper. Crisp shadows collect along each crease, emphasizing the flat angular planes of the balloon body.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Origami Zeppelin in a origami style. A folded paper airship with a long faceted cigar-shaped hull and a small creased gondola hanging beneath. Sharp mountain and valley folds define the tapered nose and finned tail, all formed from a single sheet of pale ivory paper. Crisp shadows collect along each crease, emphasizing the flat angular planes of the balloon body. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
